# Node types

58 node types. Flags: **entry** = may be a default path source (`props.entry_point`), **bridge** = runs code as an identity (entered only through `control` edges), **data** = data asset (paths end there), **synthetic** = created by the engine, not an AWS resource. Node ids are full ARNs (or the synthetic forms below); the id patterns are `aws_enumerator.engine.graph.ids.NODE_ID_PATTERNS`.

## Synthetic node ids

Examples with the placeholder accounts 123456789012 (assessed) and 111122223333 (foreign):

| Type | Example id |
|---|---|
| `anonymous` | `aws-enumerator:anonymous` |
| `account_admin` | `aws-enumerator:account-admin/123456789012` |
| `account` | `aws-enumerator:account/123456789012` |
| `region` | `aws-enumerator:region/123456789012/us-east-1` |
| `external_account` | `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root` |
| `service_principal` | `svc:lambda.amazonaws.com` |

Well-known web identity providers get `aws-enumerator:idp/<host>`, for example `aws-enumerator:idp/token.actions.githubusercontent.com`.
